criteria.criterion: Phase 0: every agentic gate run records its distinct fetch list (tool name + primary path/query arg) in the usage log by default; checked by a unit test asserting the recorded shape for a run with known tool calls.
Overlap measurement exists: an analysis entry point reports the fraction of recorded fetches covered by a ticket's file_impact; checked by running it on recorded data.

Phase 1: the completion verifier's context includes a labelled prefetch section with ranked file_impact contents and referencing-commit diffs, bounded per-file and by the 30k-token aggregate cap; unit test pins the assembly (ranking order, bounds, skeleton marker, label).

Entrypoint boundary honoured: on the close path (graph=False) the prefetch set is the closing ticket's OWN file_impact only (no subtree walk); the subtree union + frequency ranking applies only on the graph=True deep-review path; unit test pins both selections.

Opt-in / no-op for shared callers: `assemble_context` prefetch defaults to None, and `_review_ticket_impl` / review_workflows call sites produce byte-identical context to today (no prefetch section); unit test pins the no-op for a graph=True generic review call.
The pre-load manifest records per-file full|skeleton and is exposed to the tool-wrapping seam; unit test pins its shape.
The tool surface is unchanged: the verifier retains read_file/search_files/list_directory; unit test pins the toolset with prefetch enabled.

Trusted anti-anchoring: the confirm-against-working-tree / re-read-skeleton guidance lives in the completion_verifier.md static prefix BEFORE `<!--volatile-->` (not inside the untrusted fence), and names the prefetched-contents section; a unit test asserts the paragraph precedes `<!--volatile-->` (so `successor_system_prompt` inherits it) and that the fenced section carries no behavioural directive.

Recovery successors receive the prefetch via the shared assembled ticket_context (batched successor runs, not per-criterion), and the prefetch bytes are included in the physical_context_ceiling input validation so an oversize prefetch is trimmed rather than raising; unit test pins that a successor's assembled context carries the prefetch and the ceiling accounting.
